    Profile

    Shion is a visage of ethereal beauty which steals the breaths of everyone. Shion has unparalleled skill with both dance and bladework transforming them into a deadly and flawless art form. Everywhere Shion travels to is followed by an endless line of suitors desiring to win Shion's affections. However that which they desire is reserved by Shion's younger sister. Beneath that beautiful exterior however, Shion is a deadly effecient agent working for an unknown patron. The air of mystery surrounding this lithe and haunting beauty is bound to hide many more secrets. Perhaps one of these secrets is the reason why Shion's face is often tinged with sorrow.

    Origin: Wadatsumi
    Gender: Male
